summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K announcing the currency conversion rates for its 2026 first interim dividend of 8.88 US cents per ordinary share, declared 27 August 2026, with a scrip dividend alternative under the Evergreen Scrip Dividend Scheme (new shares issued on the Hong Kong line only). UK-register holders electing cash in sterling receive approximately 6.730534 pence per share (USD/GBP 0.757943); Hong Kong-register holders receive approximately HK$0.696873 per share (USD/HKD 7.847670), both payable 22 October 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named; this is a routine dividend mechanics notice, not a special situation. Watch only for scrip take-up and fractional-share dealing facility timing.
